row.headless_refusal: agy's headless lane is unmeasured: `agy -p` prints and exits, and nothing has run it as an fno worker. Use a bare spawn for a persistent thread worker or a pane placement (--split right) for an attended one.
row.once_refusal: --once is not supported on the agy thread lane (it is persistent); agy's one-shot form is `agy -p`, whose lane is unmeasured

cursor-agent has no headless lane: --print is output-only (no --input-format, no rpc), so there is no one-shot form. Use the thread lane (a bare spawn) for a persistent worker or a pane placement (--split right) for an attended one.

row.headless_refusal: grok's headless lane is unmeasured: a signed-in live create-and-resume journey is required before it can be enabled
row.once_refusal: --once is not supported on the grok thread lane (it is persistent); grok's headless one-shot is unmeasured
row.resume_refusal: is not supported on the grok thread lane yet; the keeper row resumes by name (fno agents ask/resume <name>). Refusing rather than spawning a fresh session.

row.once_refusal: --once is not supported on the pi thread lane (it is persistent); pi has no one-shot lane - its headless stance is unmeasured
row.resume_refusal: is not supported on the pi thread lane yet; the keeper row resumes by name (fno agents ask/resume <name>). Refusing rather than silently spawning a fresh session.
